title: Reader gold equation parity

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved clarity-first roadmap and exemplar gate.

allowedWork: Canonical animation.linear-solve.solve-x visual parity in the semantic reader
Neutral shared equation rendering contracts used by editor and reader
System, reduced, full, and static motion projections
Focused conformance, visual, accessibility, performance, and route-closure tests
disallowedWork: Missing-middle, graph, diagram, code, network, provider, flashcard, WebGL, FTC, economics, or physics implementation
Semantic asset, compiler, document, scroll-clock, URL, static-output, or accepted editor redesign
Editor imports from reader or reader imports from editor
goal: Transfer the accepted x + 3 = 7 typography and causal choreography into the semantic reader without sacrificing its searchable, scrollable, URL-addressable architecture, then stop for human visual approval.

slices.title: Capture canonical and reader baselines
slices.summary: Added a repeatable seven-frame cross-surface capture with font and geometry metrics; verified the exact typography discrepancy.

slices.title: Encode named parity frames
slices.summary: Encoded seven forward story beats plus exact reverse cancellation with renderer-neutral evidence requirements; capture tooling now consumes the shared contract.

slices.title: Extract computed-style clone primitive
slices.summary: Added and browser-proved a neutral recursive computed-style clone primitive without changing either surface.

slices.title: Add font readiness and invalidation
slices.summary: Added a shared awaitable font gate with loading-done revisions and disposal, proved in Chromium.

slices.title: Migrate editor material clone
slices.summary: The accepted editor material layer now consumes the neutral style-clone primitive; continuity and story-shell browser checks remain unchanged.

slices.title: Migrate reader material clone
slices.summary: Reader material owners now use computed-style clones and initial rendering waits for final fonts; deterministic capture confirms the font-family swap is eliminated.

slices.title: Prove typography and geometry parity
slices.summary: Added executable conformance proving every visible reader clone matches its source KaTeX font properties, never resolves to Inter, and remains stable through first scroll without new layout reads.

slices.title: Define neutral visual frame API
slices.summary: Defined and validated the renderer-neutral frame/owner pose contract; the reader sampler now satisfies it through inference while retaining its public compatibility fields.

slices.title: Extract accepted motion planner
slices.summary: Moved and renamed the accepted precomputed motion planner into rendering; editor semantics, rewind, path reuse, and specialized envelopes remain proven.

slices.title: Extract semantic token projection
slices.summary: Moved semantic token sampling and application behind a neutral clock; the editor adapter is now a thin inferred mapping and all forward/rewind/accessibility tests pass.

slices.title: Generalize stable owner renderer
slices.summary: Reader symbol motion now consumes a neutral, tested native/material/target handoff policy for persistent, departing, and arriving owners.

slices.title: Persist reader material stage
slices.summary: The reader now has one viewport-level material stage; repeated relation identities retain the same DOM owner across adjacent transformations.

slices.title: Transfer subtraction choreography
slices.summary: Reader fragments now consume the accepted balanced-introduction timing: persistent symbols reserve space first, then inverse terms enter together along opposed diagonals.

slices.title: Transfer cancellation choreography
slices.summary: The reader now uses the accepted witnessed-annihilation motif: inverse terms meet and compress, a semantic zero becomes readable, then survivors compact.

slices.title: Transfer successor synthesis
slices.summary: The reader now carries 7, minus, and 3 along the accepted synthesis paths and materializes 4 before the final native handoff.

slices.title: Complete stable ownership and handoff
slices.summary: Persistent and one-sided material now take full visual authority between native endpoints with complementary opacity and no ownership dip.

slices.title: Bridge continuous scroll clock
slices.summary: The global page now provides enough semantic tail dwell for the reader line to reach progress 1000 on desktop and mobile, while retaining continuous bidirectional scroll.

slices.title: Prove exact URL restoration
slices.summary: Semantic frame URLs now override browser scroll restoration, wait for font-ready layout, survive reload, restore focus, reverse-seek exactly, and keep the final card fully visible.

slices.title: Define motion preference policy
slices.summary: The reader now has a closed policy contract: System follows the OS, Reduced retains essential continuous causality, Full forces complete motion, and only Static snaps to checkpoints.

slices.title: Implement essential reduced motion
slices.summary: System under OS reduced-motion now keeps continuous subtraction, cancellation, witness, and synthesis causality while removing decorative shadows; Static alone snaps.

slices.title: Add persistent motion selector
slices.summary: A compact accessible selector now exposes System, Reduced, Full, and Static; its inferred policy persists locally and travels in shareable URLs.

slices.title: Align prose and equation focus
slices.summary: Narrative object scope no longer floods whole equations; pointer, keyboard, and URL focus use the shared relation color and immediately update native and moving material symbols.

slices.title: Harden responsive equation fit
slices.summary: The reader equation now uses a deliberately compact KaTeX scale; seven sampled frames remain single-line and in bounds from 375px phones through desktop, with the stage heading also protected from clipping.

slices.title: Remove superseded reader sampler
slices.summary: The gold reader frame now has one motion authority: operation fragment poses also supply conformance bounds and semantic focus. Generic interpolation survives only behind an explicit fallback used when operation semantics are absent.

slices.title: Run full conformance and stop for review
